sources.fullCitation: IMDb. Name entry nm0623410, “René Nazelles.” Gives his dates as 1888–1975. Corroborated by Encyclopédisque, which records his name as René Cailleteau, and by Éliane Daphy's identification record “René Cailleteau dit René Nazelles (1888-1975) parolier”. The BnF authority heading still reads (18..-19..) and has not been revised. Accessed 31 July 2026.
